sn35.3:1.2: What is nonself should be seen as it really is with correct wisdom thus: ‘This is not mine, this I am not, this is not my self.’
sn35.3:1.8: What is nonself should be seen as it really is with correct wisdom thus: ‘This is not mine, this I am not, this is not my self.’
sn35.3:1.10: He understands: ‘… there is no more for this state of being.’”
